Title: Public preview: Azure Monitor for containers new Reports(tab) & deployment live logs

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for containers added new Reports tab to give customers one stop access to all the advanced monitoring workbooks & visualization for Kubernetes, such as Node-disk, Node-network, Workloads, Persistent Volume monitoring, and many more. These visuzalizations are now easily accessible in one click.

As part of this update Azure Monitor for containers now support access to pod Live Logs (public preview) of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) deployments. You can view real-time live logs of your Kubernetes deployments. You can search, filter & view historic deployment pod logs in Log analytics, troubleshoot, and diagnose all your deployment pod issues.

Learn more about Reports tab & Azure Monitor for containers workbooks.

Learn more about AKS resource deployment live logs.
